description: MA1: what a model costs where a cost ceiling for sub-agent roles is checked: USD per 1M tokens, input plus output list price at the short-context tier. The one price table is Python's `harness_core/kernel/budget/prices.py` (`MODEL_PRICES`); this file is its projection and Node's release copy (`domain/model-prices-release.ts`) holds the same rows: a test in each language fails when they drift. A model with no row has no price: it cannot be shown to be within a ceiling.
